hero.title: Literature Monitor
hero.description: Monitor recent biomedical papers and preprints from PubMed, Europe PMC, medRxiv, and arXiv, then review them as a screening list organized by topic match, recency, source signal, and abstract quality.
hero.selectProjectHint: Select a project in the sidebar first, then send papers into chat for analysis intake.

zotero.description: Choose and import references from Zotero folders or upload BibTeX, then search, organize, manage, and send them to project chat.
